subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 16, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - September 16, 2026**

**Top Development:**

Over 400 Arch Linux AUR Packages Hijacked to Deploy Infostealer and eBPF Rootkit

A recent security breach has affected over 400 Arch Linux AUR packages, allowing attackers to deploy an infostealer and eBPF rootkit. This highlights the importance of package manager security and the need for users to be cautious when installing packages from third-party sources. Our team is working closely with the Arch Linux community to ensure that our packages are secure and up-to-date.

**Community News:**

* Shelly 3.1.4, a GUI package manager for Arch Linux, has been updated with new features and improvements. This package manager is now available for installation on AcreetionOS.
* A prominent Arch Linux developer has resigned after a 10-year run, leaving a lasting impact on the community.

**Practical Tip:**

To ensure the security of your AcreetionOS system, make sure to regularly update your packages using the `sudo pacman -Syu` command. This will keep your system up-to-date with the latest security patches and updates.

Stay safe and secure with AcreetionOS!
